days.title: Opening night by the water
days.dek: Siargao Nomad Fest opened on Friday, Oct 16 with an opening party by the water. Our crew was filming from the start.
days.highlight: Opening Party and Late Night Out

days.title: Yoga and a Hyrox-style workout
days.dek: Saturday, Oct 17 was the fitness day at Siargao Nomad Fest: a yoga class at a local studio and a Hyrox-style session at a local gym.
days.highlight: Yoga, a Hyrox class, a cooking lesson, pool coworking and Night Connect

days.title: Island hopping day
days.dek: Sunday, Oct 18 was island-hopping day at Siargao Nomad Fest: a boat out of General Luna, a white-sand beach and lunch on the sand.
days.highlight: Island Hopping and Run Club, then an evening party

days.title: Conference day at Isola Del Sole
days.dek: Monday, Oct 19 was the first conference day at Siargao Nomad Fest, with talks on AI and building a business. Shawn spoke at 10:00.
days.highlight: Conference day at Isola Del Sole: talks on AI, building and growing. Shawn speaks at 10:00

days.title: Conference day two: work, health and money
days.dek: Tuesday, Oct 20 was the second conference day at Siargao Nomad Fest, with talks on travel, work-life balance, health and money.
days.highlight: Conference day: talks on travel, work, health and money, then trivia and a dance social

days.title: Conference day three: content, money and remote work
days.dek: Wednesday, Oct 21 was the third conference day at Siargao Nomad Fest, with talks on content, investing and working across cultures.
days.highlight: Conference day: content, investing and remote work, then an evening meetup

days.title: The last conference day, then Unconferences
days.dek: Thursday, Oct 22 was the last conference day at Siargao Nomad Fest, with morning talks and an afternoon of Unconferences.
days.highlight: Morning talks, then Unconferences: sessions led by the people in the room

days.title: Wellness Day: sunrise yoga to a pool party
days.dek: Friday, Oct 23 was Wellness Day at Siargao Nomad Fest: sunrise yoga, a beach sports day, an ice bath and a pool party.
days.highlight: Wellness Day: beach yoga, reiki, breathwork and ice bath, then a pool party

days.title: Beach day: island trips, a tournament and a foam party
days.dek: Saturday, Oct 24 was the beach day at Siargao Nomad Fest: optional island trips, a morning tournament, a biohacking night and a foam party.
days.highlight: Beach day: optional island trips, a paddle tournament, a biohacking night
